author: mia
title: Before Cup week, set a deposit limit that matches your budget
dek: Spring racing is the busiest betting fortnight of the year. Limits take two minutes to set and apply straight away when you lower them.
body:
The spring racing carnival brings the busiest betting fortnight of the year, with feature races almost every day and Cup Day on the first Tuesday of November. It is also the time when many people bet more than they planned. Every licensed bookmaker must offer deposit limits, and setting one takes about two minutes.

Why limits matter in Cup week

Carnival betting is social and fast. Office sweeps, multis with friends and live races every half hour make it easy to top up an account several times in a day. A limit set in advance does the deciding for you, before the excitement starts.

Under the national consumer protection rules, providers must prompt you to set a deposit limit when you open an account, and let you change it at any time. A lower limit applies straight away. A higher one only applies after a waiting period, usually seven days, so you cannot raise it in the heat of the moment.

Three settings worth checking

  1. Deposit limit: choose daily, weekly or monthly. For Cup week, a weekly limit that matches your carnival budget is the simplest choice.
  2. Activity statement: check last month's statement to see what you actually spent, then set the limit from that number rather than a guess.
  3. Take a break: if you would rather not bet at all during the carnival, most apps let you pause the account for a set number of days.

Setting a budget that works

A budget is easier to keep when it is specific. Decide the total amount for the fortnight, divide it across the days you plan to bet, and treat it as the cost of entertainment, like a ticket to the races.

DayPlan
Derby Day$40
Cup Day$60
Oaks Day$20
Stakes Day$30

With a plan like this, a weekly deposit limit of $150 covers the whole carnival with nothing to spare, which is the point.

Signs it is time to stop

  • Chasing losses with bigger bets on the next race.
  • Topping up from money meant for bills or rent.
  • Feeling the need to hide how much you have bet.

If any of these sound familiar, lower your limit or take a break now. You can also register with BetStop to exclude yourself from every licensed online and phone provider. Free, confidential help is available from Gambling Help Online on 1800 858 858.

The takeaway

Set your limit before the first race, not after a bad afternoon. Two minutes in the app settings now makes the rest of the carnival about the racing.
